mutation: The undecided-review branch of `mayComplete` was changed to permit completion — treating the existence of a review request as though it were an approval.
performedBy: manual mutation during Phase 3C. 'a task requiring a professional cannot be completed on an undecided review' went false: a caseworker completed a task flagged as requiring a solicitor, on the strength of a review nobody had decided. This is the same failure the review repository is arranged to prevent — a request is not a decision — reappearing one layer up, which is why the gate reads review_decisions rather than the request's status column.
